name: Wellesley Youth Commission Summer Exploration Programs
description_short: Free week-long day programs run by the Town of Wellesley for local youth entering grades 6–8. Each one is hosted by a town department: the Fire Department, the Police Department, or conservation groups. Campers may attend only one program per summer, and places are given by lottery.
swim_waterfront_notes: Eco Summer Program includes kayaking and swimming. Participants must pass a swim test to take part in water activities.

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown, and it has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). The 2027 dates, programs and lottery have not been announced.
The "free" price applies to Wellesley residents and Wellesley Public Schools students. The page does not say whether anyone else can attend.
Each program has only 13 spots and is assigned by lottery (held April 1, 2026). Campers may attend only one program per summer.
This is a town government page, not a standalone camp website. The address and phone at the bottom (525 Washington St, 781-431-1019) are for Wellesley Town Hall, not the program locations.
The Eco program runs only in good weather. Days may be canceled for rain.
WPD Youth Academy start times vary from 8:30 to 9:30 a.m.
